request: Have every CSP deferred value producer rebuild both the blocking and monitoring policies together, so they share one update path even when one is fixed text.

source.request: Have every CSP deferred value producer rebuild both the blocking and monitoring policies together, so they share one update path even when one is fixed text.
source.settled: Each CSP callback updates only its own header rather than processing both enforced and report-only policies.
source.why: Rebuilding both policies from each callback would again process an already serialized static policy as directive data.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
